the similarity function used for computing hashtag recommendations has a significant impact on the resulting set of recommended hashtags and that the use of a similarity function based on the Levenshtein distance outperforms the use of other similarity functions.

the use of a similarity measure based on the Levenshtein distance leads to better recommendations than the use of the Jaccard similarity measure and that the recommendation quality increases with the number of recommended hashtags.
